personality: 7 Dark-First Utility with 4 Tactile shapes (Premium Space Game)
personality_one_liner: A vibrant, tactile intergalactic puzzle experience set against a deep obsidian space backdrop with neon neon-candy accents.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets for gaming interaction, distinct separation between the top queue, middle dock, and bottom puzzle grid.

do's: Use on the Settings bottom sheet.
Use behind the Bottom 10% controls area to separate it from the puzzle grid.
dont's: Do not use on puzzle grid items (spaceships) or queue elements to ensure high performance.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Level selection grid and start gateway.
screens.layout: Centralized CTA layout. Top: Game Title (Neon glow text) + Settings icon. Middle: Scrollable level grid showing padlock or star ratings. Bottom: Large 'Play Latest' CTA. Background: Deep space texture.

screens.name: Game
screens.layout:
Strict Portrait Layout: 
- Top ~30%: 'Alien Terminal Queue' -> Winding path showing colorful alien passengers waiting.
- Top ~15%: 'Docking Bays' -> 2 to 4 empty ship slots where spaceships are placed to be filled.
- Middle ~45%: 'Launch Yard Grid' -> The main traffic jam board containing miniature spaceships with white directional arrows, cockpit detailing, and soft shadows (using RN Views).
- Bottom ~10%: 'Controls' -> Frosted glass bar housing Undo, Restart, Hint, and Settings buttons.

screens.name: Modals
screens.layout:
Full screen overlay with heavy glassmorphism blur and a central 'surfaceSecondary' modal card. 
- Victory: 3-Star rating animation, Next Level CTA (brandPrimary).
- Deadlock: 'No Moves Left' message, Undo and Restart CTAs.
- Settings: Toggles for Music, SFX, Haptics.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the portrait layout split (30% queue, 15% docking, 45% grid, 10% controls).
Use RN Views with border radiuses and internal shadows/gradients to build the miniature spaceships. Include directional arrows.
Do NOT use external Skia libraries; rely entirely on react-native-reanimated and standard RN styling for the puzzle elements.
Spaceships and aliens must map strictly to the 'game_entities' color palette (cyan, yellow, orange, pink, purple, green, blue, red) to ensure puzzle logic matches visual color coding.
Implement tactile chunky interactions with generous hitSlop on all spaceships (they should feel like physical board game pieces).
Ensure 'glassmorphism' is used only on the bottom control bar and modals to keep grid rendering performance optimal.
Victory and Deadlock states should block grid interaction immediately and present clear CTA paths.
